bio.text: Michael Carbone is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 25; the Arizona Legislature's member page lists the position of House Majority Leader.

In the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Carbone describes being a husband, father and small business owner who is originally from Illinois and moved to Arizona with family, and says Carbone chaired the local district Republican committee.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 25 (candidate-submitted statements)
